facts.text: As a member of SARA, Indiana Wesleyan University is authorized to deliver distance education courses and programs across all member states.

sources.title: Student Consumer Information | Indiana Wesleyan University
sources.quote: IWU is also a member institution of the National Council for State Authorization Reciprocity Agreements. As a member institution, IWU is authorized to deliver distance education courses and programs in all SARA-member states.
